boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Mount Carmel College of Nursing
boards.description: Ten currently documented food stops with late operating hours in Columbus, selected as under-21-safe options for a post-study meal run.

cards.entity_name: Mikey's Late Night Slice — High & Vine
cards.title: Mikey's Late Night Slice — High & Vine
cards.subtitle: 457 N High St, Downtown Columbus
cards.notes: Check the location page before leaving, then order at the Downtown counter; its listed daily closing time is at least 2:30 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Downtown pizza counter with late hours documented directly by the business.
cards.evidence_claim: Mikey's lists this High & Vine location at 457 N High St and publishes hours until 2:30 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Mikey's Late Night Slice — High & Vine
cards.access_notes: Business-published hours: 11 a.m.–2:30 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; 11 a.m.–3 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Confirm before travel.

cards.access_notes: The restaurant posts 11 a.m.–midnight Wednesday–Monday and 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Tuesday. Confirm before travel.

cards.evidence_claim: Taco & Grill lists 2864 N High St and posts hours through midnight Monday–Thursday and through 2 a.m. Friday–Sunday.
